requirements.requirement: Preserve latest audit repairs and reconcile source versus installed runtimes
Version contracts and make optional capabilities independently available
Expose already acquired temperature p10/p90; preserve mean versus median
Selectively acquire additional quantiles within explicit cost/resource budgets
Compare native direct/total solar against the current decomposition
Use dew point, pressure, wind components, and cloud structure appropriately
Measure actual hourly refresh value and separately identify near-term correction
Test adaptive temperature correction and locally calibrated marginal uncertainty
Provide stress scenarios; evaluate dependence-aware household scenarios before probabilities
Compare all three rain products and a bounded occurrence/amount challenger
Preserve provider, cost, archive, privacy, authority, and historical replay boundaries
Integrate accessible UI, observability, complete tests, and scoped rollout
Disposition longer-range display, station-grid limits, and deliberately unused capabilities

tasks.title: Reconcile the merged audit and actual operating state
tasks.gate: no dependent model selection uses a known-broken evaluator; the plan does not restart repaired audit work. Actual runtime and access facts are recorded, not assumed from repository defaults.

tasks.title: Freeze capability contracts, acquisition profiles, and budgets
tasks.gate: an explicit contract and safe migration exist before producers change. Request expansion respects existing guards; denial degrades optional capability, not correctness or core availability.

tasks.title: Deliver the existing temperature uncertainty end to end
tasks.gate: existing acquired uncertainty reaches the UI and evaluator correctly without changing deterministic model behavior. Mean-only forecasts still work when the range is unavailable.

tasks.title: Add bounded statistics and atmospheric collection
tasks.gate: actual or fixture acquisition demonstrates every enabled band under cost/resource bounds, and optional groups cannot strand the established core pipeline.

tasks.title: Implement and evaluate native direct/total solar
tasks.gate: conserved interval semantics and train/serve parity; later held-out PV/thermal comparison; recorded disposition. “Native components available” is not permission to replace the current method.

tasks.title: Add atmospheric context and controlled feature ablations
tasks.gate: added fields have useful, truthful consumers; feature groups get evidence-backed dispositions; no atmospheric field silently grants action authority or changes PV cooling wind.

tasks.title: Evaluate actual hourly updates and a near-term correction profile
tasks.gate: the project can measure whether hourly refresh helps the forecasts it actually serves. New near-term corrections have independent identity, fallback, source binding, and evidence; an interim source cannot corrupt extended products.

tasks.title: Implement bounded local marginal calibration
tasks.gate: full implementation and tests exist, with results on all eligible data and specific evidence blockers otherwise. A contender that loses remains unselected; raw ranges and current point forecasts remain usable.

tasks.title: Build household stress cases and test coherent scenarios
tasks.gate: useful stress cases work independently of probability qualification. Scenario software, experiments and explicit uncertainty limits are complete even if real evidence requires the probabilistic product to remain unavailable.

tasks.title: Compare precipitation products and local occurrence/amount
tasks.gate: no gain is promoted for looking good only on dry days. Each head and candidate has matched coverage, scores, uncertainty and a clear retained/selected/deferred disposition.

tasks.title: Complete UI, observability, and capability dispositions
tasks.gate: every recommendation has a disposition; no fabricated probability, freshness, physical calibration, or completeness claim reaches the UI.

tasks.title: Verify, stage, and deliver the integrated system
tasks.gate: changes are reviewable and tested against the actual current source; deployment/operation claims have their own evidence. The agent does not mark unsupported candidates as winners to close the task.

regressions.scenario: Current/legacy schemas, missing supplemental report
regressions.expected_result: Existing deterministic UI/replay remain valid

regressions.scenario: Optional quantile/dewpoint/cloud group fails
regressions.expected_result: Core forecast remains valid; group explains missingness

regressions.expected_result: Accepted and truthfully labeled

regressions.scenario: Crossing/nonfinite quantiles; mean outside nominal range
regressions.expected_result: Reject malformed quantiles; do not reject a valid mean merely for lying outside the range

regressions.scenario: 273.15 K and a 10 K spread
regressions.expected_result: 32°F value and 18°F spread, without applying the temperature offset to a spread

regressions.scenario: Expanded profile against old cached subset
regressions.expected_result: Old cache cannot falsely satisfy new fields; originals unchanged

regressions.scenario: Two writes approach byte/object cap in one cycle
regressions.expected_result: Second write checked against updated usage; no overrun

regressions.scenario: Restricted quota/late provider run
regressions.expected_result: Bounded retries/deferred optional work, no billing or fallback provider

regressions.scenario: Solar 1.8 MJ total / 1.08 MJ direct over 1 h
regressions.expected_result: 500/300/200 W/m² total/direct-horizontal/diffuse

regressions.scenario: Ideal constant 30° elevation
regressions.expected_result: 300 W/m² direct-horizontal corresponds to 600 W/m² DNI

regressions.scenario: Real varying elevation/hour crossing/terrain masking

regressions.scenario: Missing direct or substantial direct>total

regressions.scenario: Same inputs to training and serving

regressions.scenario: u/v cardinal directions and calm

regressions.scenario: Mixed pressure conventions or absent indoor humidity

regressions.scenario: 23/25-hour Denver day, 1 mm/h mean

regressions.scenario: 48 h interim arrives >7 h after init

regressions.scenario: Late run or observation discovered after decision
regressions.expected_result: Cannot enter historical as-issued features or selection

regressions.scenario: Many forecasts verify against one observation

regressions.scenario: Joint scenario resampling/template selection

regressions.scenario: New consumer/source closure with old admission

regressions.scenario: Selector changes then child exits unsuccessfully

regressions.scenario: Long-horizon score plus restart/late observation
